method: Bidirectional exact point-to-triangle distances using a spatial index; deterministic area-weighted samples plus vertices and targeted XYZ/radial extrema in named diagnostic regions. Target triangles are subdivided to tighten bounding boxes without changing their surfaces.
diagnostic_subregions_note: These narrower bands describe the gear flanks, locating flange, indexing tabs and rounded rim. They do not replace strict whole-region acceptance.

omitted_underside_branding.description: Recessed lettering on the underside is intentionally replaced by the original bottom plane. Only this central underside box is excluded from retained mechanical acceptance; its distances remain in the whole-exterior and raw gear-region measurements.

regularization.mechanical: Native arcs, planes and ruled transitions replace triangulated source surfaces. Mechanical acceptance remains 0.1 mm with no tolerance exception for regularization.
regularization.grip: The long capsule foot blend is regularized to a smooth native surface. Differences above Z=18.4 are reported separately and are not treated as gear, locating-flange or neck fit acceptance.
regularization.snap_joint: Both native blanks are fused before comparison. New sockets, spring slots and retention features are absent from this exterior audit.

acceptance: Passed means the native blank is valid and every sampled point in both retained mechanical regions is within 0.1 mm in both directions. It does not assert full exterior equality, grip equivalence or physical fit.
limitations: A sampled comparison, not a proven Hausdorff bound. Source volume is descriptive only. This audit does not test snap deflection, assembly force, torque capacity, printer accuracy or a physical print.
